1q4f7g0:229: The three-layer architecture of Kiro Job Scheduler embodies the core philosophy of serverless design—each layer has a single responsibility, clear boundaries, and independent scaling. The scheduling layer (EventBridge Scheduler) handles reliable triggering without participating in business logic; the orchestration layer (Dispatcher Lambda) handles configuration reads and container startup, being pure stateless compute; the execution layer (ECS Fargate) runs the actual workload with on-demand start and stop. The practical value of this layering is fault isolation—scheduling-layer retries do not interfere with execution-layer container lifecycles, and execution-layer container crashes do not propagate to scheduling reliability.
